description: Qwen 3.8 Flash Next UD-Q6_K_XL by Unsloth
gpu_tip: ~175GB total at 128K context. A 16GB GPU (e.g. RTX 5080) plus a 192GB DDR5 kit covers it — the experts are sparse enough that offloading most of them to system RAM costs much less speed than the size suggests.
mac_tip: Needs ~175GB — exceeds every MacBook Pro; a Mac Studio (M3 Ultra with 192GB+ unified memory) is required.
